svg.text: Solar SUV v4 - power and thermal flow
Energy from the PV skin and the grid to the wheels and the cabin; coolant and refrigerant from the front-end module to the battery, e-axles and HVAC. Values are full-size design figures.
1 Energy: solar + grid -> battery -> e-axles -> wheels (regen braking reverses the orange path)
solar strings (SELV, < 60 V): A-pillar wire channels
Daily PV yield 2.3-2.6 kWh = 12-14 km at 19 kWh/100 km. Pack 93.7 kWh usable = ~490 km. System peak 400 kW (150 + 250 kW). Regen recovers up to 0.3 g into the pack.
2 Thermal: front-end module, heat pump, battery and e-axle loops, cabin HVAC
blend doors; defrost, 4 face, 2 foot vents
modes: A/C, heat pump, battery chill,
